adoption.notes: Implementation-ahead hardening: the runtime applies these clauses to every Ed25519 key it admits, including keys that frozen contracts admit, ahead of their successors. Its capability matrix and module docstring say it applies the clauses and is held to the vendored corpus; neither states that it implements or conforms to this version, so neither is a qualifying claim and the version is not frozen by this merge. The Android runtime's Rust admission is held to the same vendored corpus. The recorded implementation applies clauses 1 to 4. Clause 5, mixed_order, was added to this draft after it, so until the runtime adopts it the runtime refuses fewer keys than this version.
